status: decided by delegated authority, owner may override
rule: Every literal that reports an OS version or product identity in src/ must be declared here with the declared value. Undeclared identity literals and mismatched literals fail tools/check_os_identity.py. The policy is the only source of identity values; per-call ad-hoc values are not allowed.

dwMajorVersion.basis: Windows 10/11 kernel family; golden manifest reports 10.0.26200

wProductType.basis: VER_NT_WORKSTATION; reference host EditionID Professional (manifest ProductName 'Windows 10 Pro', build 26200.9457). The golden corpus has no product-type probe; the value was confirmed on the live reference host via Win32_OperatingSystem.ProductType = 1
